mn: MN is a hard brittle grey polyvalent metallic element that resembles iron but is not magnetic.
MN can also mean a midwestern state.
MN means the same as manganese or atomic number 25 or Minnesota.
mnemonic: Mnemonic means of or relating to or involved the practice of aiding the memory.
Mnemonic can also mean a device used to aid recall.
Mnemonic means the same as mnemotechnic or mnemotechnical.
mnemonics: A mnemonics is a method or system for improving the memory.
mnemonist: A mnemonist is an expert in the use of mnemonics.
mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is the Titaness who was goddess of memory.
mniaceae: Mniaceae is family of erect mosses with club-shaped paraphyses and the hexagonal cells of the upper leaf surface.
Mniaceae means the same as family Mniaceae.
mnium: Mnium is mosses similar to those of genus Bryum but larger.
Mnium means the same as genus Mnium.
mnemotechnic: Mnemotechnic means of or relating to or involved the practice of aiding the memory.
Mnemotechnic means the same as mnemonic or mnemotechnical.
mnemotechnical: Mnemotechnical means of or relating to or involved the practice of aiding the memory.
